Spring Equinox Citrus Salad

Served at: Spring Equinox (Ostara)

Serves 4-6Prep 25 min

This vibrant Citrus Salad celebrates the balance and renewal of the Spring Equinox, or Ostara. Featuring a medley of bright, juicy citrus fruits and a refreshing honey-mint dressing, it symbolizes the returning light and fresh energy of spring. It's a perfect light and invigorating dish to share as nature awakens.

Ingredients

  • 2 large Navel Oranges
  • 2 Blood Oranges (if available)
  • 1 large Ruby Red Grapefruit
  • 2-3 Mandarins or Tangerines
  • 1/4 cup (about 30g) fresh Pomegranate seeds (optional)
  • 2 tablespoons (30ml) fresh Lime Juice (from 1-2 limes)
  • 1 tablespoon (15ml) Honey
  • 1 tablespoon (15ml) finely chopped fresh Mint leaves
  • Pinch of salt

Method

  1. Prepare the citrus fruits: Using a sharp knife, slice off the top and bottom of each orange and grapefruit.
  2. Stand each fruit on one of its cut ends. Carefully slice downwards, following the curve of the fruit, to remove all the peel and white pith.
  3. Working over a bowl to catch the juices, carefully slice between the membranes to release individual citrus segments. Discard any seeds.
  4. Place the segmented citrus fruits in a large serving bowl.
  5. For the dressing: In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice, honey, finely chopped mint leaves, and a pinch of salt until well combined.
  6. Pour the dressing over the citrus segments. Gently toss to coat.
  7. If using, sprinkle the pomegranate seeds over the salad just before serving.
  8. Serve immediately or chill for up to 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

Tips

  • For an extra floral note, add 1/4 teaspoon (1.25ml) of orange blossom water to the dressing.
  • Experiment with different citrus varieties like Cara Cara oranges or pomelos for varied color and flavor.
  • Garnish with a few extra fresh mint leaves for a beautiful presentation.
